copy.tagline: 掌握红队攻击各阶段与反侦察手法
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果 你负责网络安全攻防演练或想了解攻击者思路
copy.tagline_en: Learn red team attack phases and evasion techniques
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you lead security drills or want to understand attacker tactics

howto.what: 当用户咨询红队安全测试时，Claude 会基于 MITRE ATT&CK 框架分阶段讲解攻击生命周期，说明侦察、入侵、提权、横向移动等环节，并介绍检测规避方法、报告要点和道德边界。
howto.when: 当用户询问攻击模拟、渗透测试或红队战术时，Claude 会按其原则给出阶段化建议。

say.text: 用 MITRE ATT&CK 列出一次模拟攻击的完整阶段
say.note: Claude 会给出攻击生命周期各阶段要点。

say.text: 介绍几种规避检测的常用手法
say.note: Claude 会列举 LOLBins、混淆、日志清除等。

say.text: 帮我写一份红队测试报告框架
say.note: Claude 会按叙事和检测缺口结构生成。

howto.what_en: When asked about red team security testing, Claude explains the attack lifecycle based on the MITRE ATT&CK framework, covering phases like reconnaissance, initial access, privilege escalation, lateral movement, and also covers detection evasion, reporting principles, and ethical boundaries.
howto.when_en: This is triggered when the user asks about attack simulation, penetration testing, red team tactics, or MITRE ATT&CK-related principles.

say_en.text: List the full phases of a simulated attack using MITRE ATT&CK
say_en.note: Claude outlines the attack lifecycle phases.

say_en.text: Introduce some common detection evasion techniques
say_en.note: Claude lists LOLBins, obfuscation, log clearing, etc.

say_en.text: Draft a red team testing report framework
say_en.note: Claude builds a report with narrative and detection gaps.
